notes:
Barco UDX-4K22: 4K UHD (4096x2160), 3-chip DLP laser-phosphor large-venue projector, ~20,000-21,000 center lumens, not rack-mountable (installation projector; ceiling/truss/floor mount). Dimensions 660x830x350mm, weight 87.5kg/193lbs. Power: 120-160V (reduced power) / 200-240V (+/-10%), 20A, 50-60Hz, max 1,900W @230V, standby <10W.

Sourced primarily from Barco's own official documentation: support page https://www.barco.com/en/support/udx-4k22, the UDX User Manual (R5906112, Appendix A.5 "Specifications of the UDX-4K22" and Chapter 8 "Input & Communication"), and the UDX Installation Manual (R5906113, section 4.3 power connection) hosted at barco.com/manuals — cross-checked against retailer-hosted copies of Barco's own datasheet (Full Compass, ProjectorCentral).

Caveats / inferred items:
- SDI channel A/B/C/D grade+direction breakdown reflects the "Pulse Quad Combo Input Mk II" board detailed in the manual; the model's own summary datasheet line just says "Quad 3G/12G SDI / BarcoLink ULTRA" (4x BNC). Board ships in Mk I/II/III revisions depending on production date; DMX only works with Mk III in slot L1.
- The UDX-4K22-specific spec table states "Single HDBaseT" (used here); the Mk II board section separately describes two HDBaseT inputs — likely a board-revision difference, not a fixed spec.
- Optional/accessory items not listed as ports because their connector type isn't in the allowed list or isn't stated: WiFi module and GSM/cellular module (each optional, with antenna connectors), optional "Quad DisplayPort 1.2" input board, optional "Fiber SFP" input board, and an unspecified "sync connections" item noted on the communication-panel component list.
- Wired-remote XLR pin count (assumed 3-pin) and the 12V accessory output's physical connector style (assumed barrel-style) are not explicitly stated in the manual text retrieved — best-effort inference.
- AC inlet is only described as a "power input socket" secured by a "locking plug holder clamp"; exact IEC sub-type (assumed C19/C20 given the 1,900W draw and onboard 25A circuit breaker) is inferred, not explicitly named in the manual.
- No internal speakers/audio I/O on this projector.

ports.name: SDI A
ports.note: Quad Combo input channel A; 3G-SDI or 12G-SDI

ports.name: SDI C
ports.note: 3G-SDI input, or configurable as loop-through output of SDI A (up to 12G)

ports.name: SDI D
ports.note: 3G-SDI input, or configurable as loop-through output of SDI B

ports.name: HDBaseT
ports.note: Also carries Ethernet pass-through; standard board ships with 1x port (some board revisions/Mk II add a 2nd)

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Master USB-A for firmware updates / log file download

ports.name: DMX In
ports.note: DMX-512; requires Quad Combo Mk III input board in slot L1

ports.name: DMX Out
ports.note: DMX-512 loop-through; requires Quad Combo Mk III input board in slot L1

ports.name: Wired Remote
ports.note: XLR input for wired RCU control (IR alternative); pin count not stated in manual, inferred as 3-pin

ports.name: 12V Output
ports.note: 12V, max 1A, active when not in standby; physical connector style not explicitly specified in manual, inferred

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: Power input socket with locking plug-holder clamp; exact IEC sub-type not named in manual, inferred from 1,900W/20A-breaker power class
